research_question: Owner-approved addition: 7 Best Legal CRM Software Platforms for Law Firms. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for legal crm software, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Law firm owners, legal operations staff, and legal teams in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; LexisNexis InterAction+ removed (no usable screenshot of the vendor page; LexisNexis blocks automated readers); HubSpot prices updated to the promotional Starter $7 and Professional $90 shown on the pricing page, with regular prices noted; Clio Grow Elite and add-on packaging claim cut (Clio blocks automated readers and the screenshot does not show it); Law Ruler usage-fee terms claim cut (not found in fetched terms text).
